evidence.title: GitHub - mubeng/mubeng: An incredibly fast proxy checker & IP rotator with ease. · GitHub

name: mubeng
summary: Proxy checker and IP rotator that verifies proxy lists and rotates your IP across HTTP, SOCKS and AWS proxies.
description: A fast proxy checker and IP rotator written in Go. It verifies the availability of the proxies in a list, or runs as a proxy server rotating your exit IP every N requests; supports HTTP(S), SOCKS v4(A)/v5 and Amazon API Gateway proxy strings, and works as an upstream proxy behind Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP.
contains: proxy checker: live/dead verification, country filter (ISO-3166 alpha-2), custom output templates
proxy IP rotator: rotates the exit IP every N requests (sequent or random)
supports HTTP(S), SOCKS v4(A)/v5 and Amazon API Gateway proxies
env-var substitution and helper functions in proxy pool files
installs as a binary, Docker image, or from Go source
Burp Suite upstream proxy and OWASP ZAP proxy chain examples
